scope: Exact supplied reviewer messages recovered from this chat. Claims and limits remain those of each review; not an independent test rerun.

messages.author: /root/studio_grace
messages.text:
**Recommendation:** Proceed after defining DSP acceptance thresholds.

**Rationale:** Separate studio deployment, explicit quality selection, atomic staging, and preserved v1 artifacts provide credible recovery boundaries.

**Blocking Issues:** Specify ratio-dependent sinc cutoff and numerical alias, passband, THD, and CPU limits before building; “reduction” alone cannot determine acceptance.

**Non-Blocking Improvements:** Preserve last working project on every failure; expose retryable export errors and recovery from processor failure.

**Verification Required:** Test schema rejection, interrupted replacement/export, stale checks, worklet crashes, repeated imports, v1 hashes/render parity, downloaded ZIP reconstruction, sprite boundary playback, and keyboard audio activation. These are execution gates.

**Confidence:** High on architecture; performance and fidelity remain unverified.

messages.author: /root/studio_hypatia
messages.text:
**Recommendation:** Proceed after two prebuild clarifications.

**Rationale:** Optional schema2 and preserved schema1 bound compatibility risk; provenance and unsupported adoption/model claims are appropriately constrained.

**Blocking Issues:** Pin numeric export byte/count/duration limits and fixed ZIP paths. Define studio privacy boundaries: current server statically serves authoring journals under `evidence/`; exclude private journals from serving and delivery.

**Non-Blocking Improvements:** Explain source declarations versus verified ownership and local model requirements beside export/setup.

**Verification Required:** Execution gates: reject malformed/oversized inputs, traversal and metadata injection; confirm loopback/8772 origin restrictions, atomic rejection, v1 compatibility, downloaded ZIP provenance/PCM identity, actual Phaser playback, DSP/worklet parity.

**Confidence:** High on proposal; implementation unverified.

messages.author: /root/studio_cray
messages.text:
Recommendation: Proceed with opt-in studio DSP; retain the exact classic path.

Rationale: Precomputed phase coefficients avoid per-sample trigonometry. Cutoff must depend on resampling ratio; fixed full-band sinc still aliases when downsampling.

Blocking Issues: Whole-validator time is unmeasured. Schema 1 must preserve interpolation, transfer, defaults, and exported behavior exactly.

Non-Blocking Improvements: Cache bounded coefficient tables; allocate nothing inside processing. Performance Impact: convolution multiplies per-voice sampling work.

Verification Required: Measurement Required: cold/warm complete validation with six 30-second cases, 512 KiB banks, maximum voices, all supported rates; require <15 seconds. Measure worklet p99/max against block deadlines, independent spectral rejection, unity low-level transfer, knee continuity, and bit-identical classic PCM.

Confidence: Medium; architecture inspected, proposed DSP unbenchmarked.

messages.author: /root/studio_grace
messages.text: Yes—the prebuild specification blocker is resolved. Ratio-dependent cutoff, numeric fidelity thresholds, cold validation budget, and an explicit disable/defer gate now define acceptance. Frozen v1 paths and bounded delivery scope support recovery. Spectral quality, worst-case performance, worklet parity, atomic failure handling, and actual downloaded sprite playback remain unverified execution gates.

messages.author: /root/studio_hypatia
messages.text:
Prebuild boundary blockers resolved. Fixed paths, numeric export limits, loopback binding, and a public-file allowlist establish concrete constraints; preserved 8771 remains outside this upgrade.

Execution tests still required: oversized export rejection, exact ZIP contents, traversal/encoded-path/symlink rejection, journal exclusion, origin enforcement, and downloaded-pack provenance/PCM identity. Approval covers the proposal, not verified implementation.

messages.author: /root/studio_hypatia
messages.text:
No blocking disclosure, traversal, symlink, ZIP-path, or HTML-metadata defect found in this read-only review.

The ZIP writer accepts an exact generated filename set, adds only fixed supplemental paths, enforces compressed/uncompressed limits, and stages publication. Imported metadata remains JSON; consumer output and receipt labels use `textContent`, and receipts download as JSON blobs. Static serving rejects traversal and symlink components and excludes raw authoring journals.

One low-priority availability gap remains: `studio/server.py:212–216` reads the declared body without a socket deadline, before admission control. A local client sending valid headers with `Content-Length: 100` and only one body byte can retain a handler thread indefinitely; repeated connections can exhaust resources. Set a request-read timeout and test incomplete bodies. This is not evidence of remote exploitability.

Scope limits: I inspected source and existing test definitions; I did not run write-producing tests, probe external assets, or verify actual browser download/model behavior. Those execution gates remain open.

messages.author: /root/studio_cray
messages.text:
No confirmed DSP correctness bug found. Classic construction remains untouched; studio interpolation is ratio-dependent, allocation-free inside processing, and the transfer is exactly linear through ±0.8.

Three evidence gaps deserve attention:

- **[P2] Negative-control assertion is nonspecific.** `test-contract-budget.mjs:13–15` accepts any contract failure and reports `deliberateHeadroomFailureDetected: !cold.pass`. Assert the expected case contains the pre-limiter-peak failure, with no unexpected failures. Otherwise an unrelated regression can satisfy this gate.

- **[P2] “Maximum” processor timing is overstated if applied beyond its fixture.** `test-studio-quality.mjs:27` times the default bank and five-layer rig; maximum prepared-bank/six-layer timing occurs separately in offline validation. Either describe these measurements separately or time the processor with that maximum fixture. Observed Node p99 values have substantial margin, but do not establish browser deadline reliability.

- **Spectral coverage is narrow.** Image, alias, and passband measurements use 48 kHz output; passband probes cover only 1/3 kHz source tones. Add the worst supported downsampling step—48 kHz source →32 kHz output at 1.25×—and a 44.1 kHz fractional-ratio probe before claiming improvement across supported rates. Current measured-tone claims are supported.

Performance impact: the coefficient bank adds **411,840 bytes per module realm**, beyond decoded audio memory. Report this separately from `decodedBytesPerRealm`; measured RSS already captures the Node process.

Rerun the final helper’s receipts as planned. Existing ~3.09-second cold and ~2.95-second warm results support the bounded local workload, without physical-device, browser scheduling, or listening-preference guarantees. Confidence: medium-high.

messages.author: /root/studio_grace
messages.text:
Three actionable findings:

- **P1 — Default audio cannot start.** [server.py:157](<original-workspace>/soundrig-proof/studio/server.py:157) omits `worklet.mjs` from the public allowlist. Fresh studio initialization uses the default player, whose processor URL is `/worklet.mjs`; Enable audio therefore receives a 404 before any generated project is activated. Allow this fixed runtime module.

- **P2 — Exported component host link returns 404.** The same allowlist omits `exported.html`, while [app.mjs:178](<original-workspace>/soundrig-proof/studio/app.mjs:178) exposes that URL after successful component export. Allow the retained host page so this existing export workflow remains usable.

- **P2 — Valid short imported cues cannot be delivered.** [delivery-cli.mjs:18](<original-workspace>/soundrig-proof/studio/delivery-cli.mjs:18) derives trace duration from sample length plus 20 ms, but the renderer requires traces of at least 100 ms. Import accepts recordings from 4 ms. An in-memory reproduction accepted a 20 ms synthetic pickup, then delivery failed with `Invalid trace duration`. Clamp rendered clip length to at least 4,800 frames, retaining trailing silence and exact marker lengths.

I found no additional quality propagation or landing lifecycle defect in the inspected paths. Full regressions, live Meta, browser playback, and fault-recovery behavior remain unverified; no files or evidence were written.

messages.author: /root/studio_grace
messages.text:
All three findings are **resolved**:

- **Default audio:** `worklet.mjs` is allowlisted; the nine-test receipt covers HTTP 200. Root also observed “Audio on.”
- **Exported host:** `exported.html` is allowlisted and covered by the passing HTTP check.
- **Short cues:** Delivery clamps to 4,800 frames and triggers at frame zero. The passing regression checks 100 ms output and audible onset before 5 ms.

The browser Meta receipt also confirms `patch-9b3fe8e65e92`, 44.947 seconds, with all three contracts passing. No tests rerun or files written.

messages.author: /root/studio_hypatia
messages.text:
Resolved for the reported incomplete-body trigger. The server applies a five-second socket idle timeout, returns HTTP 408, closes the connection, and rejects truncated bodies. The new raw-socket test covers that trigger; the receipt records all nine tests passing.

This verifies an idle timeout, not an absolute upload deadline. No tests or writes performed during this recheck.

messages.author: /root/studio_cray
messages.text:
**Resolved:** All three prior findings.

- Negative control now requires the specific pre-limiter-peak failure, excludes unexpected failures, and requires the other five cases to pass.
- Processor timing now uses the actual 524,288-byte prepared bank, six layers, and repeated 12-event bursts. Current Node p99 is **0.197–0.215 ms**; recorded maxima remain below each measured quantum budget.
- Added worst-step 48→32 kHz/1.25× alias probe (**86.36 dB reduction**) and 44.1 kHz source/fractional-ratio passband probe (**0.0178% error**). Source-rate passband coverage expanded.
- Transfer helper retains exact low-level identity; continuity tests cover both knees.
- Refreshed receipts record **3.26 s cold**, **2.95 s warm**, and **6.32 s combined**.

**Partial/unresolved:** None from this targeted review. Warm contract results are timed but only their hash is compared; cold assertions substantiate the negative control.

Claim boundary: these are local Node measurements and specified synthetic-tone results. They support the bounded workload and measured probes, without proving universal spectral quality, physical/browser deadlines, listening preference, or worst-case behavior on other machines. Coefficient memory remains **411,840 bytes per realm**, additional to decoded PCM.

Review covers supplied screenshots and sampled source. Functional results in the packet were not independently rerun.

If needed, produce a true alpha-matted raster record asset, preserving the grooves and original avatar.
4. **Floor:** remove the “SoundRig / delivery check” eyebrow in [delivery-consumer.html](<original-workspace>/soundrig-proof/studio/delivery-consumer.html); carry the selected display lettering into this consumer and [workflow-host.html](<original-workspace>/soundrig-proof/studio/workflow-host.html), including necessary font files in their portable packages instead of system-font display headings.
